To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the accuracy of an automatic sentiment analysis is influenced by the specific language used by customers and the company.

the results of an automatic sentiment analysis depend on the language used in a firm’s Social Media channels, which is why the approach needs to be adapted to the language used in the respective Social Media channels.
the results from an automatic sentiment analyses are not accurate enough to be used in a business context.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: 1.
the question whether a firm can rely on the accuracy of an automatic sentiment analysis in the context of Social Media posts.
the question of how SMEs can make use of Social Media for improving their customer relationships and for gaining competitive advantage.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the accuracy of the automatic sentiment analysis of posts in Social Media of SMEs depends on the linguistic and structural properties of the posts.
a high level of precision can be achieved with the use of an adapted approach for sentiment analysis.
an automatic sentiment analysis is not suitable for all SMEs and that an individual approach is necessary.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the accuracy of sentiment analysis can be increased by the usage of a specific lexicon for the company and its region.
SMEs should not rely on a one-size-fits-all solution when it comes to the automatic sentiment analysis of their Social Media posts.

the use of Social Media in small and medium-sized companies can provide companies with a great deal of information about the customers’ satisfaction and dissatisfaction, which can be analyzed with a sentiment analysis.
The main takeaway from our work is that
SMEs should consider the specific characteristics of their customer base and their posts before applying an automated sentiment analysis to the posts.
SMEs have to adapt the sentiment analysis to their specific context in order to benefit from the advantages of an automatic analysis of Social Media posts.
the accuracy of a sentiment analysis of Social Media posts is not solely determined by the quality of the underlying algorithm, but also by the specific characteristics of the posts under analysis.
